gaps.name: diff-prose
gaps.reason: The diff component has no wrapping variant: its lines always scroll sideways. A diff of prose (.md, .txt) is one long line per paragraph, unreadable at phone width unless it wraps; code keeps the component's own scrolling lines.

gaps.name: qr
gaps.reason: The catalogue has no QR code. Settings → Add a device shows the sign-in address with a one-time code as a QR code for a phone's camera, which reads it most surely dark on light, so it keeps that in dark mode too, with colour tokens only.
